purpose: match people, skills, tools and time to the work, and show where there are gaps before they delay delivery
procedure: List the skills and roles needed for each phase and the amount of effort in each.
Compare with available people, counting leave, support duties and other commitments.
Find the gaps and decide how to close each: hire, borrow, train, contract or change the plan.
Plan lead times for access, equipment, licences and environments, which often take longer than expected.
Avoid single points of knowledge by pairing or planned handover on critical skills.
Review the plan at checkpoints and when people join or leave.
acceptance_criteria: Availability counts leave and other duties
Each gap has an action and an owner
Lead times for access and tools are planned
Critical skills are covered by more than one person
validation_method: Project manager review with team leads.

validation.check: compare allocated percentages per person with their available hours
check each gap has an action, owner and date

failure_modes.mode: One person holds a critical skill

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A plan needs two backend engineers for six months. One is available at 50 percent, so the gap is closed by a contractor with access requested three weeks ahead and a handover plan for the integration knowledge.
